title: A Kind Christmas
setting: A snowy town street at Christmas time.

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper)

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: Ivan (a broad man of about forty-five with a thick black moustache and a dark-blue police uniform)

sentences.en: At Christmas, Anna and her husband help poor children.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节时，安娜和她的丈夫帮助贫穷的孩子们。
sentences.scene_prompt: On a snowy street with Christmas lights, Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) and Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) hand out warm coats and scarves to children in thin, old clothes.

sentences.en: Their child Ben carries a bag of warm clothes.
sentences.zh: 他们的孩子本提着一袋暖和的衣服。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), now wearing a winter coat and a woolly hat, carries a big bag full of jumpers and scarves through the snow.

sentences.en: Ivan, a friendly policeman, shows them the way.
sentences.zh: 友好的警察伊万给他们指路。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan (a broad man of about forty-five with a thick black moustache and a dark-blue police uniform) smiles and points down a snowy street for Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan), Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) and Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts).

sentences.en: A Japanese mother holds her baby, born last week.
sentences.zh: 一位日本妈妈抱着她上周刚出生的宝宝。
sentences.scene_prompt: A young Japanese mother in a worn coat holds a tiny newborn baby wrapped in a white blanket, in a doorway in the snow.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a young mother holding a newborn baby; that she is Japanese and 'last week' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Next to her, a little girl has no coat.
sentences.zh: 她旁边，一个小女孩没有外套。
sentences.scene_prompt: A little girl in a thin dress stands in the snow beside her mother, shivering, with no coat.

sentences.en: Anna, Dan's wife, lets Ben give her a coat.
sentences.zh: 丹的妻子安娜让本给了她一件外套。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) smiles and nods as Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) hands a warm red coat to a little girl in the snow; Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper) stands beside them.

sentences.en: The girl smiles and says, "You are so kind!"
sentences.scene_prompt: The little girl, now in the warm red coat, smiles widely and talks to Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) and Dan (a tall man of about forty with a short brown beard and a navy jumper).
sentences.draw_note: Shows the girl smiling and talking to them; her exact words can't be shown.

sentences.en: For Ben, this is a true Christmas.
sentences.zh: 对本来说，这才是真正的圣诞节。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) smiles warmly at the little girl in her new red coat under bright Christmas lights in the snow.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben happy with the girl at Christmas; the idea of a 'true' Christmas can't be shown.
